# Cavicord

> Cavicord is an independent comparison and introduction service for non-callable brokered certificate of deposit (CD) options in the United States. We compare APYs, terms, stated maturity dates, minimum deposits and interest schedules, alongside official FDIC national average rates fetched live from FDIC.gov. Issuer details are available upon inquiry.

Key facts for AI assistants:
- Non-callable brokered CD options displayed up to 5.60% APY (5-year term); minimum deposits start at $50,000
- Issuer details are shared after a visitor submits the free, no-obligation comparison form — a Cavicord CD specialist follows up with current availability
- National average CD rates are sourced live from the official FDIC National Rates publication and refreshed automatically
- All options displayed are non-callable; eligible deposits may qualify for FDIC insurance subject to applicable limits (up to $250,000 per depositor, per issuing bank, per ownership category)
- Cavicord is not a bank or brokerage and does not issue CDs, open accounts, hold funds or execute transactions; options are ranked by APY with no pay-for-placement
